Sirentide — E₈ root-system Coxeter plane

Live renderer output — the SVG below was produced by Sirentide from the DSL beside it.

rootsystem
type: E8
edges: minimal

A finite crystallographic root system. type: accepts the classical A<n>/B<n>/C<n>/D<n> families through the explicit rendering cap n ≤ 24, and E6/E7/E8/F4/G2. Roots are closed under the shared Cartan matrix's simple reflections, then projected into a deterministic Coxeter/Petrie plane. edges: minimal (the default) draws the complete minimal-distance root links when they fit the 10,000-line cap; edges: none keeps just the points and distinct-radius guide rings. Separate Coxeter orbits can share a guide radius; E8 is the exceptional clean eight-rings-of-30 case. This complete 6,960-anchor figure is static-only because it exceeds the 512-frame play-through cap.
